newsitem.title: USA: Sagebrush Q4 shr $0.12 vs pro forma $0.12.
newsitem.headline: Sagebrush Q4 shr $0.12 vs pro forma $0.12.

text.p: Note: (a) Fiscal 1996 includes 53 weeks for the year and 17 weeks in the Q4 compared with 52 weeks and 16 weeks, for fiscal 1995.

(b) Prior to Jan. 1996, most of the corporations comprising the Company were S corps for federal and state income tax purposes, with their taxable income allocated to the shareholders rather than taxed at the corporate level.

Pro forma net income and net income per share for the Q4 and the fiscal year ended Dec. 29, 1995, reflect (i) the application of corporate income taxes to its income before income taxes at a 39 percent effective tax rate and (ii) a $500,000 anticipated charge to "General and administrative expenses" on an annual basis ($150,000 for the fourth quarter and $500,000 for fiscal 1995) to increase certain of the Company's executive officers' salaries to more representative levels in connection with the its Jan. 1996 IPO. The pro forma net income and net income per share is presented as if such changes had been effected on Dec. 31, 1994.

(c) Pro forma weighted average shares outstanding is calculated as if all shares of Sagebrush common stock outstanding immediately prior to the public offering (4,500,000) were outstanding since Dec. 31, 1994 and reflects the subsequent issuance of shares at $7.00 per share, less offering expenses and underwriting discounts, necessary to fund certain cash payments and S corp distributions to or for the benefit of its existing shareholders in connection with a reorganization effected concurrently with the initial public offering.
Note: Full company name is Sagebrush Inc.
